about.title: About
about.subtitle: Hit the jackpot, after dark.
about.body: Lucky 2000 is a midnight doughnut drop in Abu Dhabi — golden zalabiyeh meets Italian zeppole, fried fresh and filled with playful, high-quality flavours. Strong black sweet tea on the side. Every visit should feel like pulling the lever and watching the reels land.
